description: This Java class configures the DelegatingAuthenticationService within a Spring Boot application. It defines beans for authentication service properties, connection factory, and token validation helper, using Spring annotations and dependency injection.

classes.name: DelegatingAuthenticationServiceConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class that exposes beans for authentication service properties, connection factory, and token helper, conditioned by the profile '!authentication-impl'.

methods.name: authenticationServiceClientProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for connecting to the remote authentication service, using properties prefixed with 'hono.auth'.

methods.name: authenticationServiceConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a connection factory bean for the authentication service, utilizing the Vertx instance.

methods.name: tokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a token validation helper bean, adjusting validation config for TLS if necessary, for JWT validation.
